title: Molecular characterization of chikungunya viruses associated with outbreaks in Kenya from 2017 to 2020.
abstract: Emerging outbreaks of the arbovirus chikungunya virus affect millions of individuals globally, causing debilitating arthralgia and fever. A study on the burden and etiologies of acute febrile illnesses (AFI) in Kenya reported an increase in CHIKV cases in Mombasa between December 2017 and December 2019. In January and February 2020, another outbreak of CHIKV occurred in Dadaab-Hagadera. Using next-generation sequencing on the Illumina MiSeq platform, we established molecular characteristics and phylogenetic differences of the CHIKVs collected from the two epidemiologically distinct settings. Sequenced viruses belonged to the Indian Ocean Lineage and clustered according to geographic region, with E1:K211E and E2:V264A mutations present in both settings. Additional mutations previously reported during Kenyan CHIKV outbreaks and suggested to influence CHIKV adaptation to Aedes albopictus, including E1:T82I and E1:V84D, were also identified. These molecular markers provide useful information on CHIKV spread and can help strengthen outbreak preparedness and response. Clinical features were described only for laboratory-confirmed CHIKV cases from the AFI surveillance cohort and compared with AFI cases testing negative for CHIKV. Sore muscles, headache, and convulsions were more frequently reported among CHIKV-positive participants, whereas diarrhea was less common. No differences were observed in the frequency of cough, skin rash, conjunctivitis, or vomiting. Given the limited number of confirmed CHIKV cases and the predominance of young children in the cohort, the reported clinical symptom associations should only be interpreted as exploratory and warrant confirmation in larger and more representative populations.

abstract_zh: 虫媒病毒 基孔肯雅病毒 的新出现 暴发 影响全球数百万人,导致 关节痛 衰弱和发烧。一项关于肯尼亚急性发热性疾病 (AFI) 负担和病因的研究报告称,2017 年 12 月至 2019 年 12 月期间,蒙巴萨的 CHIKV 病例有所增加。2020 年 1 月和 2020 年 2 月,达达布-哈加德拉发生了另一起 CHIKV 暴发。利用 Illumina MiSeq 平台上的新一代测序,我们确定了从两种流行病学不同的环境中收集的 CHIKV 的分子特征和系统发育差异。已测序的病毒属于印度洋谱系,并根据地理区域进行聚类,两种环境中均存在 E1:K211E 和 E2:V264A 突变。之前在肯尼亚 CHIKV 暴发 期间报道的其他 突变 并建议影响 CHIKV 对白纹伊蚊的适应,包括 E1:T82I 和 E1:V84D,也被确定。这些分子标记提供了有关 CHIKV 传播的有用信息,并有助于加强 暴发 的准备和应对。仅描述了 AFI 监测 队列研究 实验室确诊的 CHIKV 病例的临床特征,并与 CHIKV 检测呈阴性的 AFI 病例进行了比较。CHIKV 阳性参与者更常报告肌肉酸痛、头痛和抽搐,而腹泻则不太常见。咳嗽、皮疹、结膜炎或呕吐的频率没有观察到差异。鉴于确诊的 CHIKV 病例数量有限且 队列研究 中幼儿占多数,所报告的临床症状关联仅应解释为探索性的,并需要在更大且更具代表性的人群中进行确认。

title: Chikungunya waves in 2025 signal risk of endemicity in China.
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) transmission in Guangdong, southern China, intensified markedly in 2025, with successive outbreak waves in Foshan and Jiangmen followed by wider dissemination across all 21 prefectures during a peak domestic travel period. By late 2025, more than 25,000 cases had been reported, suggesting a departure from the historically import-driven and geographically limited outbreaks previously observed in China. These observations raise the possibility of an early transition towards more sustained transmission, although repeated introductions followed by local amplification remain an alternative explanation. Key contributing factors include mobility-associated amplification, climate variability, flood-related expansion of mosquito breeding habitats, favourable urban ecology, and incomplete interruption of transmission during cooler months. Although winter temperatures are suboptimal for sustained transmission, vector persistence and possible vertical viral transmission may permit low-level circulation between epidemic waves. In this context, distinguishing repeated importation from local persistence becomes critical. Preventing endemic establishment will require sustained inter-epidemic surveillance, anticipatory vector control, and clearer policy pathways for deployable vaccination strategies.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了2025年中国南方广东省的CHIKV 传播模式,重点关注佛山和江门的暴发波,以及随后在国内旅游高峰期传播到所有21个地市的情况。

elements_zh.main_results: 到2025年底,已报告超过25,000例病例,表明该疾病从历史上以输入为主且地理分布有限的暴发模式,转变为更为广泛的传播模式。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,中国可能会尽早过渡到持续的CHIKV 传播,这凸显了需要区分重复输入和本地持续存在,以了解流行病学动态。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了持续的流行间 监测、预期的 媒介 控制以及开发可部署的 疫苗接种 策略以防止地方性 CHIKV 传播 建立的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于报告的病例数和环境因素,这可能无法完全解释所有 传播 动态,并且由于缺乏对局部持久性的直接实验确认,证据并不充分。

title: Comprehensive Clinical Evaluation Demonstrates Favorable Safety, Robust Neutralizing Antibody Responses, and Broad Population Immunogenicity to a Chikungunya Virus Virus-like Particle Vaccine (VIMKUNYA)
abstract: Abstract The chikungunya virus (CHIKV) virus-like particle (VLP) vaccine, VIMKUNYA TM , has demonstrated favorable safety and immunogenicity throughout its clinical development program. Here, we present aggregated safety outcomes from 5 phase 2/3 trials and immunogenicity outcomes from 4 trials conducted at multiple US sites in healthy participants aged 12 to 95 years. Participants received a single intramuscular 40 μg dose of CHIKV VLP vaccine or placebo. Immunogenicity was assessed using serum neutralizing antibody (SNA) titers (NT 80 ), geometric mean titers (GMTs), and seroresponse rates at predefined timepoints. Preclinical nonhuman primate (NHP) data indicated that the regulatory clinical seroresponse threshold (NT 80 ≥100) is more conservative, approximately 4-fold higher than titers associated with sterilizing immunity, prompting exploratory analyses at additional thresholds: NT 80 ≥25.7 (associated with sterilizing immunity in NHPs) and NT 80 ≥15 (assay lower level of quantitation). This exploration of other relevant thresholds may provide valuable context for healthcare professionals and policy makers when evaluating immunization strategies. The CHIKV VLP vaccine elicited rapid and robust neutralizing antibody responses: 47% of recipients achieved NT 80 ≥100 at 7 days postvaccination (Day 8), rising to 96% at 2 weeks and 97% by 3 weeks postvaccination, with 85% maintaining seroresponse at 6 months (Day 183). At Day 8, 92% of participants achieved the NT 80 ≥15 assay threshold and 86% achieved the NHP NT 80 ≥25.7 biological threshold; at Day 183 these responses were maintained by 99% and 98%, respectively. Younger participants and females exhibited more rapid early responses and more sustained seroresponse at later timepoints, reflecting age- and sex- associated immunologic gradients. The vaccine was well-tolerated; most adverse events were mild or moderate, predominantly injection site pain, headache, fatigue, and myalgia. No vaccine-related safety signals or cases of CHIKV-like illness were identified. Older adults reported fewer solicited and unsolicited adverse events than younger age groups, and no treatment‐related serious adverse events observed, supporting a favorable safety profile across all age groups. Together, these findings demonstrate that a single dose of CHIKV VLP vaccine induces rapid, high-magnitude, and durable neutralizing immunity with a favorable safety profile, supporting its use in individuals aged ≥ 12 years and its suitability for broad public health implementation.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study aggregated safety outcomes from 5 phase 2/3 trials and immunogenicity outcomes from 4 trials conducted at multiple US sites involving healthy participants aged 12 to 95 years.
analysis.methods: Immunogenicity was assessed using serum neutralizing antibody (SNA) titers (NT 80 ), geometric mean titers (GMTs), and seroresponse rates at predefined timepoints. Preclinical nonhuman primate (NHP) data informed the analysis of additional thresholds for NT 80 titers.
analysis.main_results: At 7 days postvaccination, 47% of recipients achieved NT 80 ≥100, rising to 96% at 2 weeks and 97% by 3 weeks. At 6 months, 85% maintained seroresponse. Older adults reported fewer adverse events than younger participants.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results support the use of the vaccine in individuals aged ≥12 years and its suitability for broad public health implementation, particularly in regions with high CHIKV transmission.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on aggregated data from multiple trials without detailed analysis of individual trial outcomes, but the evidence is strong due to the large sample size and consistent results across age groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the safety and immunogenicity of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) VLP vaccine, VIMKUNYA TM , across multiple phase 2/3 trials conducted in healthy participants aged 12 to 95 years. The vaccine demonstrated favorable safety, with most adverse events being mild or moderate, and robust neutralizing antibody responses, achieving NT 80 ≥100 in 47% of recipients at 7 days postvaccination, rising to 96% at 2 weeks and 97% by 3 weeks. Seroresponse was maintained at 85% at 6 months. The vaccine was well-tolerated, with no serious adverse events or cases of CHIKV-like illness observed. Younger participants and females showed more rapid and sustained immune responses. These findings support the vaccine's use in individuals aged ≥12 years and its potential for broad public health implementation. The study's evidence is strong due to its large sample size and consistent results across age groups, though it relies on aggregated data without detailed analysis of individual trial outcomes.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 疫苗 (VIMKUNYA TM ) 的安全性和免疫原性,以支持其在预防 CHIKV 的公共卫生策略中的使用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究汇总了 5 项 2/3 期试验的安全性结果以及在美国多个地点进行的 4 项试验的免疫原性结果,涉及 12 至 95 岁的健康参与者。
analysis_zh.methods: 免疫原性通过预定义时间点的血清中和抗体(SNA)滴度(NT 80)、几何平均滴度(GMTs)和血清反应率进行评估。非人灵长类(NHP)的临床前数据为分析NT 80滴度的额外阈值提供了依据。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,单剂量CHIKV VLP 疫苗可诱导快速、高幅度且持久的中和免疫,具有良好的安全性,这是首次在广泛年龄范围内展示持续免疫原性的研究。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果支持将疫苗用于≥12岁人群,并表明其适合广泛公共卫生实施,特别是在基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)高流行地区。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受限于依赖多个试验的汇总数据,而未对单个试验结果进行详细分析,但证据强度较高,因为样本量大且各年龄组结果一致。

title: Predictive association between control measures and chikungunya fever incidence based on random forest and SHAP analysis.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Using the 2025 Chikungunya fever (CHIK) outbreak in Chancheng District, Foshan City, this study applied a random forest (RF) regression model combined with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to explore predictive associations, nonlinear relationships and potential thresholds between environmental-social factors and village/community-level cumulative incidence, to inform stratified control of mosquito-borne diseases. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: In this cross-sectional ecological study of 143 villages/communities, the outcome was cumulative incidence, and nine candidate covariates were assessed, including the hospitalization isolation rate, construction-site density, and population density. Multicollinearity was checked using the variance inflation factor. Model fit was evaluated by the out-of-bag (OOB) R2, RMSE, and MAE, and variable importance by %IncMSE. Robustness was tested with 100 repeated runs, bootstrap thresholds from SHAP dependence plots, and a sensitivity analysis excluding the endogenous isolation rate. On the log(1 + incidence) scale, the OOB R2 was 0.206, with underestimation of high-incidence areas. The hospitalization isolation rate had the highest importance (%IncMSE = 18.43) and was negatively correlated with predictions (ρ = -0.749), but this likely reflects reverse causation and is predictive only. Construction-site density was strongly positive (ρ = 0.855), with a stable threshold near 12.8 sites/km2; it remained the most robust predictor after removing the isolation rate (%IncMSE = 8.54). CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Construction-site density was the most robust environmental predictor, whereas population density contributed little. These exploratory, predictive associations-not causal effects-should guide risk stratification and require prospective validation with time-matched longitudinal data.

source_records.title: Predictive association between control measures and chikungunya fever incidence based on random forest and SHAP analysis
source_records.abstract: BACKGROUND: Using the 2025 Chikungunya fever (CHIK) outbreak in Chancheng District, Foshan City, this study applied a random forest (RF) regression model combined with SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to explore predictive associations, nonlinear relationships and potential thresholds between environmental-social factors and village/community-level cumulative incidence, to inform stratified control of mosquito-borne diseases. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: In this cross-sectional ecological study of 143 villages/communities, the outcome was cumulative incidence, and nine candidate covariates were assessed, including the hospitalization isolation rate, construction-site density, and population density. Multicollinearity was checked using the variance inflation factor. Model fit was evaluated by the out-of-bag (OOB) R2, RMSE, and MAE, and variable importance by %IncMSE. Robustness was tested with 100 repeated runs, bootstrap thresholds from SHAP dependence plots, and a sensitivity analysis excluding the endogenous isolation rate. On the log(1 + incidence) scale, the OOB R2 was 0.206, with underestimation of high-incidence areas. The hospitalization isolation rate had the highest importance (%IncMSE = 18.43) and was negatively correlated with predictions (ρ = -0.749), but this likely reflects reverse causation and is predictive only. Construction-site density was strongly positive (ρ = 0.855), with a stable threshold near 12.8 sites/km2; it remained the most robust predictor after removing the isolation rate (%IncMSE = 8.54). CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Construction-site density was the most robust environmental predictor, whereas population density contributed little. These exploratory, predictive associations-not causal effects-should guide risk stratification and require prospective validation with time-matched longitudinal data.

title: Re-emergence of the chikungunya virus: Emerging challenges, pathogenesis, and future directions
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), once confined to enzootic cycles in tropical forests of Africa and Southeast Asia, has re-emerged as a widespread human pathogen. Its resurgence is fueled by climate change, globalization, urbanization, and the expansion of competent Aedes mosquito vectors. In India, annual cases exceed 1 million, contributing to 70% of the regional burden. Epidemics in 2005–2006 (1.4 million cases) and recurrent outbreaks in 2016, 2019, and 2023–2025 have strained public health infrastructure. Traditional vector control strategies—larvicides, fogging, and hygiene campaigns—often fail at scale due to high costs, insecticide resistance, and socioeconomic disparities. Viral evolution, including E1-A226V mutations enhancing Aedes albopictus transmission, complicates vaccine and antiviral development. Chronic post-viral arthralgia affects 30–60% of patients, lasting years in some cases. Host-targeted antivirals (e.g., favipiravir) and emerging vaccines like IXCHIQ (approved 2023, 90% efficacy) and PXVX0317 (phase 3) are critical. The continued global spread of CHIKV underscores its potential to cause pandemics, posing challenges to international public health systems and necessitating coordinated surveillance, vector management, and vaccine deployment. India-specific trials addressing genetic diversity and prevalent comorbidities are essential. Sustained research, surveillance, and funding are needed to curb CHIKV infections and prevent future pandemics.

title: Establishment of Pseudovirus-Based Reference Materials and Nationwide External Quality Assessment for Arboviruses during the 2025 Chikungunya Outbreak.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Emerging arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and Zika virus (ZIKV) pose growing public health challenges, demanding reliable diagnostic systems to support outbreak responses. During the July 2025 CHIKV outbreak in China, the absence of domestic nucleic acid reference materials (RMs) and external quality assessment (EQA) programs hindered diagnostic standardization. METHODS: We developed pseudovirus-based RNA RMs for CHIKV, DENV, and ZIKV and certified their concentrations using digital PCR across 9 laboratories for each virus, ensuring stability and commutability with WHO international standards and clinical samples. Leveraging these RMs, China conducted its first nationwide arbovirus nucleic acid EQA program. RESULTS: All three RMs were officially approved by China's State Administration for Market Regulation, with codes GBW(E)091403, GBW(E)091405, and GBW(E)091409 for CHIKV, DENV, and ZIKV, respectively. The EQA program involved 937 laboratories across 31 provinces and employed 51 amplification kits. Over 97.5% of laboratories achieved perfect scores and >99% were qualified, reflecting strong overall testing capacity. Crucially, the EQA revealed systematic gaps: institutional differences in testing scope and performance were evident, pooled testing in blood stations missed low CHIKV levels, and reagent-dependent differences in Cycle threshold values and amplification efficiency (78.9% to 146.4%) affected low-concentration CHIKV and DENV-2 detection. CONCLUSIONS: These findings underscore the power of large-scale EQA to expose hidden inter-laboratory and reagent inconsistencies. By integrating standardized RMs with nationwide EQA, this work provides a robust framework for diagnostic harmonization, drives quality improvement, and strengthens preparedness for future arboviral threats.

title_zh: 2025 年基孔肯雅热 暴发 期间建立基于假病毒的标准物质和全国虫媒病毒外部质量评估。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Emerging arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV), dengue virus (DENV), and Zika virus (ZIKV) pose growing public health challenges, demanding reliable diagnostic systems to support outbreak responses. During the July 2025 CHIKV outbreak in China, the absence of domestic nucleic acid reference materials (RMs) and external quality assessment (EQA) programs hindered diagnostic standardization. METHODS: We developed pseudovirus-based RNA RMs for CHIKV, DENV, and ZIKV and certified their concentrations using digital PCR across 9 laboratories for each virus, ensuring stability and commutability with WHO international standards and clinical samples. Leveraging these RMs, China conducted its first nationwide arbovirus nucleic acid EQA program. RESULTS: All three RMs were officially approved by China's State Administration for Market Regulation, with codes GBW(E)091403, GBW(E)091405, and GBW(E)091409 for CHIKV, DENV, and ZIKV, respectively. The EQA program involved 937 laboratories across 31 provinces and employed 51 amplification kits. Over 97.5% of laboratories achieved perfect scores and >99% were qualified, reflecting strong overall testing capacity. Crucially, the EQA revealed systematic gaps: institutional differences in testing scope and performance were evident, pooled testing in blood stations missed low CHIKV levels, and reagent-dependent differences in Cycle threshold values and amplification efficiency (78.9% to 146.4%) affected low-concentration CHIKV and DENV-2 detection. CONCLUSIONS: These findings underscore the power of large-scale EQA to expose hidden inter-laboratory and reagent inconsistencies. By integrating standardized RMs with nationwide EQA, this work provides a robust framework for diagnostic harmonization, drives quality improvement, and strengthens preparedness for future arboviral threats.
abstract_zh: 背景:基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、登革热病毒 (DENV) 和寨卡病毒 (ZIKV) 等新兴虫媒病毒对公共卫生提出了日益严峻的挑战,需要可靠的诊断系统来支持 暴发 应对措施。在2025年7月中国的CHIKV 暴发期间,国内核酸标准物质(RM)和外部质量评估(EQA)计划的缺乏阻碍了诊断标准化。方法:我们为 CHIKV、DENV 和 ZIKV 开发了基于假病毒的 RNA RM,并在 9 个实验室中使用数字 PCR 验证了每种病毒的浓度,确保了 WHO 国际标准和临床样本的稳定性和可互换性。利用这些RM,中国开展了第一个全国性虫媒病毒核酸EQA项目。结果:这三款RM均获得中国国家市场监督管理总局正式批准,其代码分别为CHIKV、DENV和ZIKV,代码为GBW(E)091403、GBW(E)091405和GBW(E)091409。EQA项目涉及31个省份的937个实验室,并使用了51个扩增试剂盒。97.5%以上的实验室满分,99%以上合格,整体检测能力较强。至关重要的是,EQA 揭示了系统性差距:检测范围和性能的机构差异很明显,血站的汇总检测漏掉了低 CHIKV 水平,循环阈值和扩增效率(78.9% 至 146.4%)的试剂依赖性差异影响了低浓度 CHIKV 和 DENV-2 检测。结论:这些发现强调了大规模 EQA 揭露隐藏的实验室间和试剂不一致的能力。通过将标准化 RM 与全国 EQA 相结合,这项工作为诊断协调提供了强大的框架,推动了质量改进,并加强了对未来虫媒病毒威胁的准备。

title: Insights Into Chikungunya Virus Seropositivity and Clinical Manifestations During the 2024 Upsurge: A Study From Central India
abstract: BackgroundChikungunya remains a significant threat to public health in India, characterised by repeated resurgences.This study was conducted to describe the demographic and clinical profile and associated complications among chikungunya patients during the 2024 upsurge. MethodsThis retrospective observational study included patients with acute febrile illness who tested positive for chikungunya immunoglobulin M (IgM) using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) between January and December 2024.Demographic data, symptoms, comorbidities, co-infections, and complications were retrieved from institutional records.Statistical analysis was done using the chi-square test. ResultsA total of 943 patients were tested for chikungunya virus (CHIKV), of which 117 (12.4%) were positive.The majority were adults (19-49 years, 61.5%) and urban residents (60.7%).Arthralgia was the most common symptom, predominantly affecting large joints (65.8%) compared to small joints (50.4%).Rash was noted in 26.5% of cases.Complications occurred in 43.6% of patients.Among these complications, the most common was persistent arthralgia (13.7%). ConclusionThe seropositivity study of the CHIKV upsurge has provided valuable insights into the symptomatology and complications associated with chikungunya infection.Chronic arthralgia for more than three months is the most common complication seen.Although studies have described greater involvement of small joints than large joints, in our case, we have reported a higher number of large-joint involvements in chikungunya.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 监测 和 基孔肯雅病毒 暴发 的管理策略提供信息,特别是关于大关节受累的 患病率 和持续性 关节痛 并发症。

title: Chikungunya in older people: a guide for primary care nurses
abstract: Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne viral infection with an expanding global spread, driven by climate change and increased international travel, leading to more older people and people with long-term health conditions travelling abroad. Chikungunya is characterised by sudden-onset fever and severe joint pain; however, older adults may present atypically, with milder or absent fever and non-specific symptoms, increasing the risk of delayed diagnosis. Pre-travel advice, vaccination and mosquito bite avoidance are key for prevention. This article discusses the epidemiology of chikungunya, differences in clinical presentation between age groups, diagnostic approaches and key considerations for management and prevention.

title: Chikungunya-associated neuroretinitis and chorioretinitis with meningoencephalitis: A rare case report
abstract: Chikungunya is an arboviral infection classically characterized by fever, rash, and arthralgia. Ocular and neurological complications are uncommon, particularly in children. We report a rare case of a 4-year-old child who developed bilateral neuroretinitis and chorioretinitis following serologically and cerebrospinal fluid polymerase chain reaction (CSF PCR)-confirmed chikungunya infection. The child presented with visual inattention and bumping into objects one week after acute febrile illness. Ophthalmological examination revealed absent visual fixation, no perception of light, bilateral optic disc pallor, and healed choroiditis. Neuroimaging demonstrated T2 FLAIR hyperintensities corresponding to terminal myelination zones without active inflammation. The child was managed with intravenous antibiotics, intravenous immunoglobulin, and methylprednisolone. Visual prognosis remained guarded due to bilateral optic atrophy, although gradual improvement was observed during follow-up. This case highlights the importance of early ophthalmic evaluation in pediatric chikungunya infection with neurological manifestations to prevent irreversible visual loss.
journal: IP International Journal of Medical Microbiology and Tropical Diseases

title: CHIKUNGUNYA (CHIKV)
abstract: INTRODUÇÃO A chikungunya é uma doença viral causada pelo vírus chikungunya (CHIKV), cujo primeiro registro ocorreu entre 1952 e 1953, na região de Tanganica, atual Tanzânia.A infecção produz uma síndrome febril e devido a gravidade da artralgia foi chamada de chikungunya, que no idioma africano Makonde, significa "aquilo que se curva", relacionando-se a forma distorcida daqueles que foram afetados pelos sintomas graves da doença.No Brasil, foi detectada em setembro de 2014, na cidade de Oiapoque (Amapá).Devido ao grande número populacional e ao clima favorável para a proliferação do vetor, o país logo se tornou o epicentro da enfermidade na América (Butantan, 2025).Diante dos desafios relacionados à disseminação das arboviroses no Brasil, a chikungunya representa uma importante preocupação de saúde pública, especialmente por ser transmitida principalmente pelo mosquito Aedes aegypti, amplamente presente em áreas urbanas, periféricas e rurais.A expansão geográfica da doença também tem contribuído para sua relevância no cenário global, enquanto as consequências de longo prazo da infecção pelo CHIKV ainda não são completamente compreendidas (Tecelão, 2015) Consequentemente, o impacto causado pela artralgia debilitante e pelo aumento das infecções, gera na sociedade, implicações econômicas, sendo necessário o desenvolvimento de pesquisas para obter-se mais informações sobre a doença e uma análise dos indicadores de saúde para um redirecionamento dos recursos.A compreensão da patogênese do CHIKV é fundamental para o aprimoramento das estratégias de prevenção, diagnóstico, tratamento e controle da chikungunya (Tecelão, 2015) Diante desse contexto, a doença Chikungunya, que afeta milhões de pessoas, foi possivelmente intensificada por vários fatores.Aos quais incluem-se, o aumento do fluxo de viajantes, a expansão geográfica dos mosquitos, adaptação da cepa epidêmica dos mosquitos ao Aedes albopictus, mudanças climáticas e desastres naturais.Desse modo, a doença acabou sendo também negligenciada por razões como: a invisibilidade das consequências mais sérias de pessoas afetadas, a falta de priorização política, o diagnóstico difícil e a confusão com outras arboviroses.Provocando, consequentemente, impacto social e econômicos e apesar de haver
authors: Gustavo Henrique Del Conte da Silva
Alexandre Muller Zigmundo da Silva Leite
journal: DOENÇAS INFECTOCONTAGIOSAS PARASITÁRIAS NEGLIGENCIADAS NO BRASIL: IMPACTO SOCIAL E PROSPECÇÕES CONTEMPORÂNEAS

title: Limitaciones funcionales y en las actividades de la vida diaria en adultos con antecedente de fiebre Chikungunya en Asunción y Gran Asunción
abstract: Introducción: La fiebre Chikungunya cursa con artralgia que puede persistir más allá de la fase aguda y afectar la funcionalidad. Tras la epidemia registrada en Paraguay, la información local sobre limitaciones funcionales en personas con antecedente de la enfermedad es escasa. El objetivo fue describir las limitaciones funcionales y en las actividades de la vida diaria en una muestra de adultos con antecedente de fiebre Chikungunya residentes en Asunción y Gran Asunción.Materiales y métodos: Estudio observacional, transversal y descriptivo. Se incluyeron 95 adultos con antecedente autorreferido de fiebre Chikungunya, captados por muestreo no probabilístico por conveniencia mediante un cuestionario digital autoadministrado. Se aplicó una adaptación no validada del Health Assessment Questionnaire. El análisis fue descriptivo.Resultados: La muestra estuvo compuesta mayoritariamente por mujeres (67/95; 70,5 %) y por participantes menores de 30 años (61/95; 64,2 %). La mayoría se encontraba en fase subaguda: 48/95 (50,5 %) habían cursado la infección tres meses antes y 8/95 (8,4 %) seis meses antes o más. Según la clasificación global del instrumento adaptado, el 52,5 % presentó dificultad funcional leve, el 30,7 % moderada y el 16,8 % grave. La proporción de participantes con al menos «alguna dificultad» osciló entre el 53 % (levantarse de una silla) y el 67 % (subir cinco escalones).Conclusiones: En esta muestra, mayoritariamente en fase subaguda, se observaron limitaciones funcionales frecuentes en la movilidad de miembros inferiores y en la destreza manual. Los hallazgos no son generalizables y requieren confirmación con estudios de base poblacional y con diagnóstico verificado.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to describe functional limitations and daily activity difficulties in adults with a history of Chikungunya fever in Asunción and Gran Asunción, Paraguay. It was a cross-sectional observational study involving 95 adults with self-reported Chikungunya infection, recruited through non-probabilistic convenience sampling using a digital self-administered questionnaire. The Health Assessment Questionnaire, an unvalidated adaptation, was used to assess functional difficulties. The majority of participants were women and under 30 years old, with most in the subacute phase of the infection. Results showed that 52.5% had mild functional difficulty, 30.7% moderate, and 16.8% severe. The authors concluded that functional limitations, particularly in lower limb mobility and manual dexterity, were common in this subacute phase sample. However, they emphasized that these findings are not generalizable and require confirmation through population-based studies with verified diagnoses. The study's limitations include its non-probabilistic sampling method and lack of validated tools, which may affect the reliability of the results.

abstract_zh: 引言:基孔肯雅热表现为关节痛,这种症状可能持续到急性期之后,影响功能。在巴拉圭记录的疫情之后,关于基孔肯雅热病史患者功能限制的本地信息非常有限。本研究旨在描述一组居住在亚松森和大亚松森的基孔肯雅热病史成年人的功能限制及日常生活活动情况。材料和方法:本研究为观察性、横断面和描述性研究。纳入了95名自述有基孔肯雅热病史的成年人,通过方便抽样的非概率抽样方法,使用数字自填问卷进行招募。应用了未经验证的健康评估问卷改编版。分析为描述性分析。结果:样本主要由女性组成(67/95;70,5 %),且大部分参与者年龄小于30岁(61/95;64,2 %)。大多数处于亚急性期:48/95(50,5 %)的感染发生在三个月前,8/95(8,4 %)发生在六个月前或更早。根据改编工具的整体分类,52,5 %的参与者出现轻度功能困难,30,7 %出现中度功能困难,16,8 %出现严重功能困难。至少有“一些困难”的参与者比例在53 %(从椅子上站起来)到67 %(上五级台阶)之间波动。结论:在这一主要处于亚急性期的样本中,观察到下肢活动和手部灵巧性方面的常见功能限制。这些发现不具备普遍性,需要通过人群基础研究和确诊诊断来确认。

title: Scorpion Peptides in Antiviral Drug Discovery: An In-depth Review.
abstract: Despite remarkable progress in the fields of vaccinology and antiviral therapy, viral infections persist as a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Therefore, it is crucial to identify new and effective antiviral drug candidates. Scorpion venoms are viewed as a rich source of structurally diverse and biologically active peptides, which may present opportunities for diagnostic, preventive, and therapeutic applications. This review intends to provide a contemporary and detailed analysis of scorpion-derived peptides, with a particular focus on their structural diversity, cytotoxic effects, antiviral properties, and mechanisms of action. Additionally, this paper highlights several potential fruitful areas for future studies. Current evidence indicates that scorpion-derived peptides are effective against a wide array of medically important viral pathogens such as chikungunya virus, dengue virus, enterovirus 71, hepatitis B virus (HBV), herpes simplex virus 1, human immunodeficiency virus 1, influenza A virus (IAV), severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2, and Zika virus. Nevertheless, the majority of these findings have been obtained from in vitro studies, whereas evidence from animal models remains limited and clinical evaluation in humans is currently unavailable. Available studies suggest that these peptides may act through diverse mechanisms of action, including direct virucidal activity, inhibition of viral entry, immune system modulation, reduction of virus-induced cytopathic effects, and suppression of viral gene expression. Emerging evidence also demonstrates the efficacy of certain scorpion-derived peptides in animal models of HBV, IAV, and Newcastle disease virus infection. Overall, such peptides appear to inaugurate new avenues for the treatment of viral infections.

abstract_zh: 尽管在疫苗学和抗病毒药物疗法领域取得了显著进展,病毒感染仍然是全球范围内发病率和死亡率的主要原因之一。因此,识别新的、有效的抗病毒药物药物候选物至关重要。蝎子毒液被视为结构多样且具有生物活性的肽的丰富来源,这些肽可能在诊断、预防和治疗方面提供机会。本综述旨在提供关于蝎子来源肽的当代且详细的分析,特别关注其结构多样性、细胞毒性、抗病毒药物特性以及作用机制。此外,本文还强调了未来研究的几个潜在有前景的领域。现有证据表明,蝎子来源的肽对多种重要的医学病毒病原体有效,例如基孔肯雅病毒、登革热病毒、肠病毒71型、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)、单纯疱疹病毒1型、人类免疫缺陷病毒1型、甲型流感病毒(IAV)、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒-2(SARS-CoV-2)以及寨卡病毒。然而,大多数这些发现来自于体外研究,而来自动物模型的证据仍然有限,且目前尚无人类临床评估。已有研究提示这些肽可能通过多种作用机制起效,包括直接病毒灭活作用、抑制病毒进入、调节免疫应答、减少病毒诱导的细胞病变效应以及抑制病毒基因表达。新兴证据还表明,某些蝎子来源的肽在HBV、IAV和新城疫病毒感染的动物模型中显示出有效性。总体而言,这些肽似乎为治疗病毒感染开辟了新的途径。

title: Antiviral responses of Aedes mosquitoes to Old World alphaviruses.
abstract: Aedes (Ae.) aegypti and Ae. albopictus are efficient vectors of medically important Old World alphaviruses including chikungunya virus. In contrast to the well-characterized responses to orthoflavivirus infections, antiviral defense against alphaviruses in Aedes mosquitoes remains comparatively underexplored. This review summarizes current knowledge of antiviral defense mechanisms in Ae. albopictus, integrating insights from both intrinsic immune responses and extrinsic antiviral factors to translational relevance. RNA interference (RNAi) dominates the antiviral defense against alphaviruses, whereas canonical immune signaling pathways, including Toll, IMD, JAK/STAT and JNK demonstrate relatively limited, transient or species-specific activity. To establish persistent infections, alphaviruses have developed various immune evasion strategies, such as the expression of viral suppressors of RNAi (VSRs) as an RNAi counter-mechanism. Beyond acute antiviral responses, piRNAs derived from viral-derived DNA (vDNA) and endogenous viral elements (EVE) have been proposed to contribute to long-term immune memory. In addition to intrinsic immune defenses, superinfection exclusion and Wolbachia infection further shape vector competence to alphaviruses. Together, this review describes RNAi as the central defense relative to the context-dependent canonical signaling pathways, extrinsic factors to influence vector competence such as microbial interaction and superinfection exclusion, and highlights key concepts and challenges necessary for designing effective and sustainable arbovirus control strategies.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on the antiviral responses of Aedes mosquitoes to Old World alphaviruses, specifically Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), and examines the mechanisms by which these mosquitoes defend against CHIKV infections. The central question is to understand the intrinsic and extrinsic factors that influence vector competence and antiviral defense against CHIKV.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a systematic analysis of current knowledge on antiviral defense mechanisms in Aedes mosquitoes against Old World alphaviruses, including CHIKV. It integrates findings from intrinsic immune responses and extrinsic factors such as microbial interactions and Wolbachia infection. The review does not explicitly report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates, but it summarizes existing literature and proposes mechanisms for long-term immune memory.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that RNA interference (RNAi) is the dominant antiviral defense mechanism against alphaviruses, including CHIKV, in Aedes mosquitoes. Canonical immune signaling pathways such as Toll, IMD, JAK/STAT, and JNK show limited or species-specific activity. Additionally, the review highlights the role of piRNAs derived from viral-derived DNA and endogenous viral elements in contributing to long-term immune memory. It also notes that superinfection exclusion and Wolbachia infection are important extrinsic factors that shape vector competence to CHIKV.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review identifies that the mechanisms of antiviral defense against alphaviruses in Aedes mosquitoes are not fully understood, particularly in comparison to the well-characterized responses to orthoflavivirus infections. There is limited evidence on the long-term effects of piRNAs and the role of specific immune pathways in persistent CHIKV infections. The review also notes that the evidence on immune evasion strategies by alphaviruses is still emerging and requires further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on elucidating the molecular mechanisms of RNAi and canonical immune signaling pathways in Aedes mosquitoes against CHIKV. It also emphasizes the need for studies on the role of piRNAs and extrinsic factors such as Wolbachia infection in shaping vector competence. These findings could inform the development of more effective and sustainable arbovirus control strategies, including the use of RNAi-based interventions and the manipulation of microbial communities in mosquitoes.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the antiviral responses of Aedes mosquitoes to Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an Old World alphavirus. It highlights that RNA interference (RNAi) is the primary defense mechanism against CHIKV, while canonical immune pathways like Toll, IMD, JAK/STAT, and JNK show limited or species-specific activity. The review also discusses the role of piRNAs derived from viral-derived DNA and endogenous viral elements in long-term immune memory. Additionally, it notes that superinfection exclusion and Wolbachia infection are important extrinsic factors influencing vector competence. The findings suggest that further research is needed to understand the molecular mechanisms of antiviral defense and the potential for RNAi-based interventions and microbial manipulation in controlling CHIKV transmission.

title_zh: Aedes蚊对旧世界甲病毒的反应机制
source_body_en: Aedes (Ae.) aegypti and Ae. albopictus are efficient vectors of medically important Old World alphaviruses including chikungunya virus. In contrast to the well-characterized responses to orthoflavivirus infections, antiviral defense against alphaviruses in Aedes mosquitoes remains comparatively underexplored. This review summarizes current knowledge of antiviral defense mechanisms in Ae. albopictus, integrating insights from both intrinsic immune responses and extrinsic antiviral factors to translational relevance. RNA interference (RNAi) dominates the antiviral defense against alphaviruses, whereas canonical immune signaling pathways, including Toll, IMD, JAK/STAT and JNK demonstrate relatively limited, transient or species-specific activity. To establish persistent infections, alphaviruses have developed various immune evasion strategies, such as the expression of viral suppressors of RNAi (VSRs) as an RNAi counter-mechanism. Beyond acute antiviral responses, piRNAs derived from viral-derived DNA (vDNA) and endogenous viral elements (EVE) have been proposed to contribute to long-term immune memory. In addition to intrinsic immune defenses, superinfection exclusion and Wolbachia infection further shape vector competence to alphaviruses. Together, this review describes RNAi as the central defense relative to the context-dependent canonical signaling pathways, extrinsic factors to influence vector competence such as microbial interaction and superinfection exclusion, and highlights key concepts and challenges necessary for designing effective and sustainable arbovirus control strategies.
abstract_zh: Aedes(Ae.)aegypti和Ae. albopictus是传播重要旧世界甲病毒(包括基孔肯雅病毒CHIKV)的有效媒介。与对正黏液病毒(orthoflavivirus)感染反应机制的充分研究相比,Aedes蚊对甲病毒的防御机制仍相对未被充分探索。本综述总结了Ae. albopictus对甲病毒的防御机制,整合了内在和外在因素对翻译相关性的见解。RNA干扰(RNAi)在Aedes蚊对甲病毒的防御中占据主导地位,而经典的免疫信号通路,包括Toll、IMD、JAK/STAT和JNK,表现出相对有限、短暂或物种特异性的活性。为了建立持续感染,甲病毒已发展出多种免疫逃逸策略,例如通过表达RNAi抑制因子(VSRs)来对抗RNAi机制。除了急性反应,来自病毒衍生DNA(vDNA)和内源性病毒元件(EVE)的piRNA被提出可能有助于长期免疫记忆的形成。除了内在免疫防御,超级感染排除和沃尔巴克氏体(Wolbachia)感染进一步影响Aedes蚊对甲病毒的易感性。综上所述,本综述描述了RNAi作为Aedes蚊对甲病毒防御的核心机制,相对于依赖于上下文的经典信号通路,以及外在因素如微生物相互作用和超级感染排除对蚊媒易感性的影响,并强调了设计有效且可持续的虫媒病毒控制策略所需的关键概念和挑战。

title: Quantitative Meta-Analytic Framework for Aedes Habitat Heterogeneity.
abstract: Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus are invasive mosquitoes and the primary vectors of dengue, Zika, yellow fever, and chikungunya. Their ecological traits, particularly larval habitats and adult resting sites, are critical for designing effective strategies to reduce mosquito abundance and disease transmission. A systematic review was conducted following the PRISMA 2020 guidelines to identify studies published between January 1998 and December 2024 in PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Web of Science. We implemented a random-effects model to estimate the relative abundance of adult female Ae. albopictus across indoor and outdoor environments, adjusted for variability across studies. Associations between larval sites, sample types, mosquito capture methods, season, and relative mosquito abundance were evaluated using meta-regression analysis. Of 9,270 publications, 38 studies met the inclusion criteria, representing 18 countries across Asia, Africa, and the Americas. Combined data showed that 15% of Ae. albopictus were collected indoors and 85% outdoors. In studies sampling both settings, 49.43% (95% CI: 37.34 to 61.57) of Ae. aegypti were collected indoors and 56.54% (95% CI: 43.79 to 68.87) outdoors, whereas 39.78% (95% CI: 18.81 to 62.94) of Ae. albopictus were collected indoors and 62.02% (95% CI: 47.86 to 75.21) outdoors. Subgroup analysis showed that mosquito abundance varied according to larval site, mosquito life stage, season, and sampling method. Significant associations between mosquito abundance and larval sites, sample types, mosquito capture methods, and season were identified, although these associations differed by species, sampling method, and collection setting. albopictus were more abundant outdoors, whereas Ae. aegypti showed greater indoor abundance than Ae. Applying these findings can strengthen arbovirus surveillance and vector control through targeted monitoring of Aedes populations and ecological preferences.

A systematic review following PRISMA 2020 guidelines identified 38 studies from 18 countries across Asia, Africa, and the Americas. A random-effects model and meta-regression analysis were used to assess the relative abundance of Ae. aegypti and Ae. albopictus in indoor and outdoor environments. Results showed that Ae. albopictus were predominantly collected outdoors, while Ae. aegypti showed greater indoor abundance. title: Pediatric Arboviral Infections in Europe: Epidemiology, Clinical Features, Diagnosis and Prevention
abstract: Arboviral infections, including West Nile virus (WNV), dengue virus (DENV), chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and, to a lesser extent, Oropouche virus (OROV), pose a heterogeneous and evolving challenge for pediatric health in Europe. The increasing presence of competent vectors and international travel has resulted in both imported infections and, for selected arboviruses, documented autochthonous transmission events. Although pediatric cases are often underrecognized, children may develop severe manifestations, including neuroinvasive disease and congenital infection. Available data on pediatric arboviral infections in Europe remain limited and fragmented, complicating accurate assessment of disease burden and clinical risk. This review summarizes current evidence on the epidemiology, clinical presentation, diagnostic challenges, and prevention of selected arboviral infections in children within the European context, highlighting persistent gaps in pediatric-specific data and implications for preparedness and public health.

title: Genomic Epidemiology of CHIKV During the Largest Outbreak in Mainland China-Implication for CHIKV Intervention
abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) has caused recurrent epidemics across tropical and subtropical regions globally. In 2025, Guangdong, China, experienced the largest documented CHIKV outbreak in mainland China, with 23,464 reported cases across all 21 prefecture-level cities. We conducted integrated epidemiological, genomic, and phylodynamic analyses to investigate the outbreaks origins, transmission dynamics, and CHIKV lineages evolution. The Guangdong strain belongs to the East/Central/South African (ECSA) genotype, Middle African lineage (MAL; ECSA-MAL) -- one of several CHIKV lineages that co-circulated globally in 2025; a long internal branch separates it from previously sequenced relatives, indicating substantial surveillance gaps in endemic regions. Phylodynamic analysis using a local molecular clock model estimated the viral introduction occurred within a narrow window in early April 2025 (95% HPD: March 26-April 12) suggesting a 2.5-month cryptic transmission prior to detection. The prolonged silent phase aligns with vector dynamics: the Mosquito Ovitrap Index (MOI) in the outbreak town of Beijiao, Foshan, stayed low in April (3.0) before surging to 9.0 through July--consistent with suppressed early transmission followed by seasonal amplification. Human migration from two epicenters (Foshan and Jiangmen) explained [~]50% of case distribution variance, while mosquito ecology constrained spatial spread. Phylowave analysis on global circulating strains identified 33 lineage-defining mutations across 14 epidemic sublineages, concentrated in NSP3, E1 and E2. Four of these have been experimentally validated as adaptive mutations. This study demonstrates the critical need for enhanced genomic surveillance during pre-peak months and underscores the importance of monitoring adaptive mutations across diverse ecological regions.

title_zh: 2025年大陆中国基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)最大暴发期间的基因组演变-对CHIKV干预的启示
source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) has caused recurrent epidemics across tropical and subtropical regions globally. In 2025, Guangdong, China, experienced the largest documented CHIKV outbreak in mainland China, with 23,464 reported cases across all 21 prefecture-level cities. We conducted integrated epidemiological, genomic, and phylodynamic analyses to investigate the outbreaks origins, transmission dynamics, and CHIKV lineages evolution. The Guangdong strain belongs to the East/Central/South African (ECSA) genotype, Middle African lineage (MAL; ECSA-MAL) -- one of several CHIKV lineages that co-circulated globally in 2025; a long internal branch separates it from previously sequenced relatives, indicating substantial surveillance gaps in endemic regions. Phylodynamic analysis using a local molecular clock model estimated the viral introduction occurred within a narrow window in early April 2025 (95% HPD: March 26-April 12) suggesting a 2.5-month cryptic transmission prior to detection. The prolonged silent phase aligns with vector dynamics: the Mosquito Ovitrap Index (MOI) in the outbreak town of Beijiao, Foshan, stayed low in April (3.0) before surging to 9.0 through July--consistent with suppressed early transmission followed by seasonal amplification. Human migration from two epicenters (Foshan and Jiangmen) explained [~]50% of case distribution variance, while mosquito ecology constrained spatial spread. Phylowave analysis on global circulating strains identified 33 lineage-defining mutations across 14 epidemic sublineages, concentrated in NSP3, E1 and E2. Four of these have been experimentally validated as adaptive mutations. This study demonstrates the critical need for enhanced genomic surveillance during pre-peak months and underscores the importance of monitoring adaptive mutations across diverse ecological regions.
abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 已在全球热带和亚热带地区造成反复流行。2025年,中国广东经历了中国大陆有记录的最大规模的CHIKV 暴发,所有21个地级市共报告病例23,464例。我们进行了综合流行病学、基因组和系统动力学分析,以研究 暴发 起源、传播 动力学和 CHIKV 谱系 进化。广东毒株属于东部/中部/南非 (ECSA) 基因型、中非谱系 (MAL;ECSA-MAL),这是 2025 年在全球共同传播的几个 CHIKV 谱系之一;一个长的内部分支将其与先前测序的亲属分开,表明流行地区存在巨大的 监测 差距。使用本地分子钟模型进行的系统动力学分析估计,病毒引入发生在 2025 年 4 月上旬的一个狭窄窗口内(95% HPD:3 月 26 日至 4 月 12 日),表明在检测之前存在 2.5 个月的神秘 传播。长时间的沉默阶段与 媒介 的动态一致:佛山市北滘镇 暴发 的诱蚊产卵指数 (MOI) 在 4 月份保持较低水平 (3.0),然后到 7 月份飙升至 9.0,这与 传播 早期受抑制、随后季节性放大的情况一致。来自两个震中(佛山和江门)的人类迁徙解释了病例分布差异的50%,而蚊子生态限制了空间传播。对全球流行菌株的 Phylowave 分析确定了 14 个流行亚系的 33 个谱系定义 突变,集中在 NSP3、E1 和 E2。其中四个已被实验验证为自适应 突变。这项研究证明了在高峰前几个月加强 基因组监测 的迫切需要,并强调了监测不同生态区域的适应性 基因组监测 的重要性。
